drivers: Three independent attributes (shape, fill, count) each follow clear row/column distribution or progression rules
Count rule shifts in row 3 (4,3,2 vs 3,2,1), tempting the 'column 3 always has 1' error
Rotation is tied to shape type, so the 225° distractors are eliminable once noticed
8 options span all combinations of the three ambiguous attributes, so partial rule discovery still leaves 2-4 candidates
